title: Yu Tames the Flood

source.quote: Yu dredged the nine rivers, guided the Ji and Ta rivers, and led them all into the sea.

moral: A bank cannot hold the water back — give it a road to the sea.

story.title: The Flood Comes
story.text: The flood drowned the fields, so the people fled to the hills.
story.narration: That year the flood drowned the fields and washed the crops away. The people carried their children up into the hills and watched the water rise, day after day.

story.title: A Road for the Water
story.text: Gun blocked the water with earth and failed. Yu said: give the water a road.
story.narration: Yu's father Gun tried to block the flood with earth. The banks grew higher, but after nine years the water still won. Yu said: water runs downhill, so let us give it a road. Instead of blocking it, he opened channels. The Records of the Grand Historian say he was away thirteen years, and passed his own door three times without going in.

keyMoment.question: The water is huge. What can be done?

options.text: Give it a road to the sea
Move everyone to the far hills

keyMoment.reveal: You can block one place, not every place. Water runs downhill — give it a road.

misconceptions: Water can only be blocked, so the higher the bank the safer
Gun's nine years of earth banks were completely wasted

quiz.question: Why did Gun's earth banks fail for nine years?
options: Water can be blocked in one place, but not everywhere
His banks were not high enough
He did not ask anyone for help
quiz.explanation: The water came round and over. Blocking alone could not stop it.

quiz.question: What did Yu do to tame the flood?
options: He opened channels and led the water to the sea
He built the bank up to the sky
He kept the water standing in the fields
quiz.explanation: He did not block it; he opened a way and let the water run downhill.

quiz.question: The kitchen drain is blocked. What is closest to Yu's way?
options: Push harder and plug the water in
Find the blockage and open a way through
Leave it and wait for the water to go away
quiz.explanation: Blocking only makes more water pile up; find the way out and clear a path.

levelScript.hint: Drag a way to the sea
